benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: At least one year of complimentary DashPass membership plus up to $10 monthly credit on grocery and retail DoorDash orders.
benefits.terms: Requires activation by Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this deadline is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: 5x Points on Lyft
benefits.description: Earn 5x total points on Lyft rides.
benefits.terms: Promotional rate through Sep. 30, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage against theft or damage for phones on a monthly bill paid with the card, up to $1,000 per claim.
benefits.terms: Up to $1,000 per claim, maximum 3 claims per 12-month period, $100 deductible per claim.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $60,000 for collision damage or theft on rental vehicles with MSRP up to $125,000.
benefits.terms: Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per ticket for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed more than 12 hours or requires an overnight stay.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed more than 6 hours.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days (90 days for NY residents), up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties by an additional year, up to 4 years total.

benefits.name: Roadside Dispatch
benefits.description: On-demand roadside assistance; service fees are billed to the card at the time of dispatch.
benefits.terms: Not free — covers dispatch of services, but the service fee itself is charged to the cardholder.

earningRates.terms: Combined $150,000 cap per account anniversary year across these categories, then 1x.
